data.fund_type: An open ended retirement solution oriented scheme having a lock-in of 5 years or till retirement age (whichever is earlier).
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate long term capital gains by investing in a mix of securities comprising ofequity, equity related securities and debt instruments as per the asset allocation pattern of the Scheme with a view to providea retirement investment solution to investors. However, there is no assurance that the Investment Objective of the Schemewill be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related instruments - 65%- 100% of net assets, Debt and Money Market instruments - 0%-35% of net assets,Units issued by InvITs - 0% to 10% of net assets. Please refer the Scheme Information Document for complete details.
data.fund_managers: FM 1 - Mr. Pratik Dharmshi, FM 2 - Mr. Pratit Vajani
